_template_notes.purpose: Per-wave dispatch state cho Phase 4 v2.0 3-WAVE strategy (Gói C++ Logistics 26 lanes). Wave coordinator script (.claude/scripts/wf-cmi/wave-coordinator.sh) atomic update sau khi spawn batch + gate check. Tham chiếu phase4-coverage-dispatch.md Step 4.5 và §B PRE-GATE.
populate: all_waves_complete: false khi current_wave < 4 OR có wave với gate_status=FAIL
wave_X.gate_status flow: PENDING → RUNNING → PASS | FAIL_THRESHOLD | PARTIAL_FAIL | SKIPPED
wave_X.lanes_active[]: lanes ACTIVE trong wave này (sau filter --dims + profile + skeleton-skip)
wave_X.fail_threshold: ≥3 lanes failed/timeout → trigger gate_status=FAIL_THRESHOLD + E120/E121/E122
wave_X.started_at + completed_at: ISO 8601, populate atomic khi spawn batch / batch return
fail_threshold mặc định 3 cho W1+W2, nhưng W3 chỉ có 6 lanes nên threshold 2 (E122)
Profile activation ảnh hưởng lanes_active[]: quick chỉ W1 partial, standard W1+W2+W3 partial, deep all 26

wave_1.description: Graphs-only — lanes consume Phase 2 graphs trực tiếp

wave_2.description: Cross-layer — lanes cần outputs từ Wave 1 hoặc cross-ref multi-graph

wave_3.description: Final cross-ref — lanes consume aggregated signals từ Wave 1+2
